subject: Math
prompt:
[Figure 1]

The graph models the number of mobile app downloads at the end of every three-month period, where $x$ is the number of three-month periods since the end of March 2020 and $0 \le x \le 4$. Which statement is the best interpretation of the point $(1, 800)$ in this context?

choices.A: The estimated number of mobile app downloads at the end of March 2020 was $800$.
choices.B: The estimated number of mobile app downloads increased every three months by $800$ downloads.
choices.C: The estimated number of mobile app downloads at the end of the first three-month period was $800$.
choices.D: The estimated number of mobile app downloads decreased by $800$ during the first three-month period.

explanation: Choice C is correct. The graph shows mobile app downloads over time, where the horizontal axis represents the number of three-month periods since the end of March 2020, and the vertical axis represents the number of downloads. The point $(1, 800)$ has coordinates where $x = 1$ and $y = 800$. Since $x$ represents the number of three-month periods since the end of March 2020, $x = 1$ corresponds to the end of the first three-month period after March 2020. The $y$-coordinate represents the number of app downloads at that time. Therefore, the point $(1, 800)$ means that at the end of the first three-month period, the estimated number of mobile app downloads was $800$.
